title: Karna ne apna kavach kyun phaada?
hooks: Karna ne apna amartya kavach khud phaad diya — jaante hue ab mar jayega
Indra brahmin ban ke aaya, Karna ne apni mrityu daan kar di
Amartya hoke bhi Karna ne chhodi suraksha — kyun?
hook_why: Opens with named entity 'Karna', immediate high-stakes action (tearing armor), and the consequence (death now possible) in one breath. Forces retention past 3 seconds. Matches myth-bust hook type proven in top katha Shorts.
metaphor: Golden protection circle (kavach-kundal) that Karna shatters by choice — not force — showing identity rooted in generosity outlives invincibility.

caption:
Karna ne apna amartya kavach khud phaad diya — jaante hue ab mar jayega. Kyun? Kyunki uske pita Surya ne chetaaya tha: 'Indra maange ga, dena mat.' Par daan hi Karna ki pehchaan thi.

Aaj bhi usse 'Daanveer' kehte hain, 'Amartya' nahi. Daan bada hua raksha se.

Tum hote toh kya karte? Suraksha bachte ya daan nibhate?

claims.claim: Karna was born with divine armor (kavach) and earrings (kundal) that made him invulnerable
Indra disguised as a brahmin asked Karna for his kavach and kundal as daan
Karna gave them away despite knowing it would make him mortal
Surya (Karna's father) had warned him about Indra's request
Indra gave Karna the Shakti weapon in return
